environment.browser: Chromium via Playwright, Vite development server

markdownCache.scenario: 160 different revisions of a 10,283-character Markdown document; heap measured after explicit GC

cursorUpdates.scenario: Five batches of 100 cursor moves within one line of a 10,783-character note with 30 JavaScript blocks
cursorUpdates.baseline: Before decoration and highlighting optimizations; bounded cache, task fast paths and memoized statistics were already applied

limitations: These are isolated synthetic measurements, not native Tauri process RAM or end-to-end typing latency.
Actual savings depend on note structure, library size, images, platform and WebView.
The text cache bounds entry count and aggregate source length, not exact AST byte size; one oversized current document can remain cached.
